svg.title: Database — controlled reads and understandable results
svg.desc: Follow the numbered connectors. Subnumbers identify branches or smaller steps. Optional actions and supporting relationships are labeled separately. SQL must satisfy a single read-only-query policy before database execution. The app runs queries with statement and lock timeouts, returns at most 1000 rows, flags additional matches, and preserves result values and column names. The table list is saved separately and guides AI-generated queries.
